content:
Here’s a cool new thing launching today: Cibby, a beautifully designed iOS app for physical video game collectors.

The app is by Michael Flarup, who knows a thing or two about rich software design.

“Cibby is an app built for people who love physical games,” per the website. “Explore and rediscover your collection in stunning interactive 3D.”

Big, modern Delicious Library energy.
